634:t_4:36.en:
$$葵$$
「Are you saying $$ヒイロ$$ has that?」

634:t_4:37.en:
$$カトル$$
「Yes. It's as vast and expansive as its name suggests.」

634:t_4:38.en:
$$グラハム$$
「$$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$... $$ヒイロ・ユイ#pilot$$... You truly are the forerunners of a new era.」

634:t_4:39.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Now that the Empire has left and Earth and space have begun moving toward true harmony, the world is entering a new era.」

634:t_4:40.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「What awaits us beyond that is...」

634:t_4:41.en:
$$シモン$$
「A battle on the stage of the galaxy...」

634:t_4:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「For now, let's go home. To the Earth we protected.」

634:t_4:43.en:
$n
「Let's rest for a little while. Just a little, until a new battle begins...」

634:t_4:45.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ gathered together and became a flower...」

634:t_4:46.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「And they enveloped the black hole...!?」

634:t_4:47.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ understood us and saved Earth.」

634:t_4:49.en:
$$シモン$$
「Something that beautiful was born. The fighting's over now.」

634:t_4:50.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「At that moment, I too touched the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ consciousness.」

634:t_4:51.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Their homeworld was dying, and they were searching for a way to survive...」

634:t_4:52.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So rather than each individual having its own will, the entire $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ swarm has a single will...」

634:t_4:53.en:
$$シャア$$
「They were connected by $$脳量子波$$, which coordinated the whole.」

634:t_4:54.en:
$$リディ$$
「So when they attacked humans with $$脳量子波$$, they were trying to communicate...」

634:t_4:55.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They were trying to understand one another by connecting... by becoming one...」

634:t_4:56.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Their symbiosis with the $$バジュラ$$ was probably possible because of their similar biology.」

634:t_4:57.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And now... they've come to understand humanity.」

634:t_4:58.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But why did they choose a flower?」

634:t_4:60.en:
$$シン$$
「Yes! It's the flower Princess $$マリナ$$ gave $$刹那$$!」

634:t_4:61.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「By sharing consciousness with $$刹那$$, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ gave shape to the image of peace within him.」

634:t_4:62.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But what about $$刹那$$ and $$ヒイロ$$...?」

634:t_4:64.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Look, everyone! At the center of the flower!」

634:t_4:65.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I have confirmed the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ and $$ウイングゼロ$$! Both units are safe!」

634:t_4:68.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You're one tough guy to kill, $$ヒイロ$$!」

634:t_4:70.en:
$$五飛$$
「Still, he did well to endure the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will, which could destroy even $$刹那$$'s mind.」

634:t_4:71.en:
$$カトル$$
「So he really was the Heart of Space.」

634:t_4:73.en:
$$カトル$$
「The Heart of Space... It's a phrase used by the leader $$ヒイロ・ユイ#keyword$$, for something people need in order to live in this universe.」

634:t_4:74.en:
$$カトル$$
「There are many interpretations, but I think it means a heart that understands others and accepts them.」

634:t_4:75.en:
$$タケル$$
「If we can do that, there won't be any conflict.」

634:t_4:76.en:
$$葵$$
「Are you saying $$ヒイロ$$ has that?」

634:t_4:77.en:
$$カトル$$
「Yes. It's as vast and expansive as its name suggests.」

634:t_4:78.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(Major $$グラハム$$... The future you risked your life to protect has blossomed like this.)

634:t_4:79.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
(Leave the rest to us. Rest in peace, eternal top gun...)

634:t_4:80.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Now that the Empire has left and Earth and space have begun moving toward true harmony, the world is entering a new era.」

634:t_4:81.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「What awaits us beyond that is...」

634:t_4:82.en:
$$シモン$$
「A battle on the stage of the galaxy...」

634:t_4:83.en:
$$スズネ$$
「For now, let's go home. To the Earth we protected.」

634:t_4:84.en:
$n
「Let's rest for a little while. Just a little, until a new battle begins...」

634:t_4:89.en:
???
「...I never thought they'd reconcile with the writhing metal.」

634:t_4:90.en:
???
「See? Aren't they amazing? Whatever we send in, they handle it somehow. It's so exciting to watch.」

634:t_4:91.en:
???
「Eventually they will move beyond evolution to $$シンカ$$... But the radiance of the sun cannot be allowed.」

634:t_4:93.en:
???
「It is obvious. The Earthlings of that world will be erased.」

634:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Especially you, $$グラハム$$... Allow me to praise you for overturning your fate.」

634:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That battle in which you risked your life produced no less than 1,500Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

634:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To live is to fight... The name $$ミスター・ブシドー$$ is now completely a thing of the past.」

634:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The battle in which you risked your life opened the way to humanity's future.)

634:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The 1,000Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s that it produced... I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

634:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I swear to your soul that we will always protect the future you wished for humanity.)

634:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...With that, the Earth Sphere is calm for now.」

634:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, this peace is only temporary, and those who target Earth are very much alive and well.」

634:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The army of darkness, $$ミケーネ$$, the $$堕天翅$$, $$ガイゾック$$, $$バジュラ$$, $$インベーダー#robot$$, $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

634:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And $$サイデリアル$$ and the fundamental calamity...」

634:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Will humanity really be able to survive and seize its future...?」

634:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding! Here I am spoiling this peaceful moment, however temporary it may be!」

634:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So it's business as usual today! Business, business!」

635:t_001:1.en:
$$カティ$$
「So not even an $$イノベイター$$ can turn this situation around!?」

635:t_002:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Our forces in this sector are down to 20%! Other sectors have fallen below 50% too!」

635:t_002:2.en:
$$カティ$$
「Is this... the end for us...!?」

635:t_002:3.en:
$$カティ$$
(If the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ invasion had come just one month later, that plan might have been ready in time...!)

635:t_002:4.en:
$$カティ$$
「Regrettably, we must retreat! Notify $$ネオ・ジオン$$ too!」
